scope: Native species link protocol 6, peer-local alias reconstruction and trade-animation garbage-collection roots.
github_actions: Local evidence only. The published commit runs eight production configurations and five native fixtures; check Actions separately for that exact head.

native_link.peers: Two independent PyBoy instances with different conversion-table allocation histories.
native_link.transport: Harness copies outgoing serial buffers to the other peer; real ROM packet builders, patch encoders/decoders and native import execute unchanged.
coverage: Party sizes 1 through 6, trade and battle rooms, native and legacy player input layouts; original party records unchanged by serialization.
Full native species words, canonical regional forms, cosmetic forms, egg/gender metadata, all remaining party bytes, player ID, OT names and nicknames.
Real serial patch-list round trips for control bytes 0xfd, 0xfe and 0xff, including player ID and both patch-list segments.
Real received-party battle identity publication, OT-to-temp copy and persistent party insertion after trade.
Zeroed inactive slots; 15 malformed-packet cases reject invalid counts, zero/Egg/reserved/unsupported IDs in first and last slots, wire EXTSPECIES and nonempty inactive identities.
Rejected packets leave destination records and conversion-table bytes unchanged.
Both room types reject older incompatible protocols; compatible version 6 succeeds.
Every wide fixture forces collection on its first received wide allocation from a full local table.
Four isolated trade-animation identity roots each survive 229 distinct allocations in every wide fixture.
Existing wide-species integration: generation/catching, native battle identity, names/stats/cries/pictures, PC serialization, evolution, daycare, Pokedex and primary/backup saves.

limitations: Cable interrupts/timing, physical hardware or wireless VC compatibility, complete trade animation, mail delivery and a complete linked battle are not emulated by the buffer-transfer tests.
Wide fixtures reuse existing art/stats; no full interactive wide-species playthrough or arbitrary expanded roster is claimed.
Content-specific forms/classification extensions and old-save import remain separate work. Save version 12 is unchanged.
